OVERVIEW : The Petitioner, Villadom Corp, is seeking approval for a zoning- compliant (“as -of- right”)
residential subdivision identified as the “Estates at Elwood”. The proposed major subdivision was
designed to cluster 44 of the 46 proposed single-family residential lots in the eastern and southern
sections of the 55 +/- acre subject property; thus, allowing for the preservation of 20 +/- acres of steep
slopes and natural areas, which are more prevalent in the western portion of the subject property (lot
47). The remaining two (2) residential lots (45 and 46) are situated in the southwestern portion of the
subject property along NYS Rt 25. The proposed subdivision includes construction of a 1.83 +/- acre
recharge basin and two (2) roadways, which would be dedicated to the Town.
The subject property, which is located on the north side of Jericho Turnpike (NYS Route 25) and the
east side of Manor Road within the hamlet of Elwood, Town of Huntington, is within the Town of
Huntington’s R -40 (single-family residential) zoning district. The proposed residential lots range in size
from 21,000 +/- square feet (sf) to 41,400 +/- sf and each include a one-car garage with a two-car
driveway. Though zoning for the surrounding properties to the north, east and south mostly consists
of R-40, land use of these properties includes agricultural uses, single family residences and an open
space and recreational use, Berkeley Jackson County Park, to the north. Land uses to the west the
subject property, which front along Jericho Turnpike, are zoned C-6 (General Business District) and
C-8 (General Business District A) and consist of retail, office, automobile uses, fast food restaurants,
etc., with single-family residential uses farther off the corridor that reflect the respective Residence 5
zoning. As noted in the Expanded Environmental Assessment Form (EEAF), which was prepared by
